name: CC MEETING - OCTOBER 2, 2018 - 7PM
agenda_text:
CC MEETING - OCTOBER 2, 2018 - 7PM
CC MEETING - OCTOBER 2, 2018 - 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, OCTOBER 02, 2018
07:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 1437
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3. ROLL CALL: MAYOR LEDFORD, MAYOR PRO TEM CARRILLO, COUNCILMEMBERS HOFBAUER, BETTENCOURT, AND BISHOP
4. PRESENTATIONS:
4.1 Palmdale Animal Care Center representative will present a cute critter that is available for adoption from our local Animal Care Center.
4.2 Presentation to Mayor and Council of a check from Jorge Ventura, Ventura Graphix to benefit Gabriel’s House.
5. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S) and ORDINANCE(S):
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) and/or Ordinance(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
6. CONSENT CALENDAR – PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
7. CONSENT CALENDAR:
7.1 Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books as of August 31, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.1
7.2 Approve FY 2018-2019 Purchase Order No. 20190115 with Consolidated Electrical Distributor for Electrical Supplies in an amount not to exceed $55,400, funded through multiple accounts. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.2
7.3 Approve Purchase Order Contract No. 20190101 for a new 2019 Petersen TL3 Unit Mounted on a 2019 Freightliner Chassis Lightning Loader with Nixon-EGLI Equipment Company of Southern California in an amount not to exceed $207,632, funded through Account No. 10133001-774400. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.3
7.4 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-070, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, APPROVING THE APPLICATION FOR LOCAL STREETS AND ROADS FUNDS AUTHORIZED UNDER ARTICLE 8 OF THE TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT ACT. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.4
7.5 Approve Purchase Order No. 20190254 for a CRAFCO Rubber Melter with CRAFCO, Inc. in an amount not to exceed $67,275.41, funded through Account 10133001-774400. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.5
7.6 Approve Agreement for the General Plan Update between the City of Palmdale and Raimi + Associates, Agreement No. A-6429. (Staff Reference: Director of Economic & Community Development Oyler)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.6
7.7 Accept Completed Public Improvements and Authorize the City Engineer to file a Notice of Completion and Release Securities for Completed Public Improvements – Hobby Lobby, Dollar Tree & Planet Fitness located at 10th Street West and Avenue O-8. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.7
7.8 Approve Consultant Services Agreement with PSOMAS to provide Construction Management/Office Engineering Services for the Upper Amargosa Creek Flood Control, Recharge and Habitat Restoration Project, in the amount of $954,840, funded through Account No. D0008, Agreement No. A-6412. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.8
7.9 Award Project No. 591-C, Upper Amargosa Creek Recharge, Realignment and Habitat Restoration Project, in the amount of $5,894,440 to Bowe Contractors, Inc., funded through multiple accounts, Agreement No. A-6381. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.9
7.10 Award of Project No. 757, IS Server Room Electrical Upgrade, to GA Technical Services Inc. in the amount of $139,900, funded through Account No. F0008101, Agreement No. A-6437. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.10
7.11 Approve opening Purchase Order No. 20190329 for purchase of fitness court equipment at Pelona Vista Park with National Fitness Campaign, in the amount of $85,925, funded through Account No. P0044242. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.11
7.12 Accept Completed Capital Project, Project No. 728, SAVES Freezer Purchase and Installation, with MJS Construction, Inc., and authorize the Director of Public Works to file a Notice of Completion, funded through Account No. F0049280, Agreement No. A-5707. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.12
7.13 Approve the City of Palmdale’s 2018 Ten-Year Capital Improvement Plan. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.13
2018 TEN-YEAR CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PLAN
7.14 Approve the First Amendment of the Amended and Restated Joint Exercise of Powers Agreement (JPA) Between the County of Los Angeles, the City of Palmdale, and the City of Lancaster Creating the Antelope Valley Transit Authority (AVTA) to revise language to allow appointment of one or more alternate directors to the Board of Directors of the Antelope Valley Transit Authority and make other minor modifications. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.14
7.15 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-072, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE REPEALING AND RESTATING THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST CODE OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE. (Staff Reference: City Attorney Ditzhazy)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.15
7.16 Approve the minutes from the previous meetings held September 4, 2018 (5pm) and September 4, 2018 (7pm). (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar. (Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 7.16
8. PUBLIC HEARINGS:
8.1 Public hearing and review of proposed Resolution No. CC 2018-060 authorizing the Application for the 2018 Local Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant (JAG) Program. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
8.1a RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-060, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AUTHORIZING APPLICATION FOR THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE, OFFICE OF JUSTICE PROGRAMS, BUREAU OF JUSTICE ASSISTANCE, JAG PROGRAM 2018 LOCAL EDWARD BYRNE MEMORIAL JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT PROGRAM.
Staff Recommendation: Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Resolution No. CC 2018-060. (Vote - Requires a majority vote of the total membership of the City Council to adopt.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 8.1
8.2 Public hearing and review of proposed Resolution No. CC 2018-068. (Staff Reference: Director of Economic & Community Development Oyler)
Entertainment Permit No. 18-13 and Dance Permit No. 18-14
The Royal Banquet Hall, Applicant
8.2a RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-068, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING ENTERTAINMENT PERMIT NO. 18-13 AND DANCE PERMIT NO. 18-14 FOR THE ROYAL BANQUET HALL, LOCATED AT 2015 EAST PALMDALE BOULEVARD, PALMDALE, CA 93550.
Staff Recommendation: Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Resolution No. CC 2018-068. (Vote - Requires a majority vote of the total membership of the City Council to adopt.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 8.2
8.3 Public Hearing and review of proposed Resolution No. CC 2018-066 authorizing the purchase and financing of the Records Retention Building, and approving the following documents: Agreement for Purchase and Sale and Joint Escrow Instructions (A-6420); Site and Facility Lease (A-6405); Lease Agreement (A-6408); Letter Agreement for Purchase and Rate Lock (A-6406); Agreement for Municipal Advisor Services (A-6403); Agreement for Placement Agent Services (A-6404); and Agreement for Legal Services (A-6409). (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
8.3a RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-066, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING THE FORM AND AUTHORIZING THE EXECUTION OF AN AGREEMENT OF PURCHASE AND SALE AND JOINT ESCROW INSTRUCTIONS AND CERTAIN LEASE FINANCING DOCUMENTS IN CONNECTION WITH THE PURCHASE AND FINANCING OF THE CITY'S RECORDS RETENTION BUILDING WHICH WAS PREVIOUSLY LEASED BY THE CITY AND AUTHORIZING AND DIRECTING CERTAIN ACTIONS WITH RESPECT THERETO.
Staff Recommendation: Move to close the Public Hearing. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Resolution No. CC 2018-066. (Vote - Requires a majority vote of the total membership of the City Council to adopt.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 8.3
9. JOINT SPECIAL REPORT CITY COUNCIL ITEM 9.1 and SUCCESSOR AGENCY ITEM 6.1:
9.1 Review of proposed Joint Resolution Nos. CC 2018-071 and SA 2018-009 regarding the cancellation and rescheduling of the November 6, 2018 Regular Meetings. (Staff Reference: City Clerk/Agency Secretary Smith)
9.1a JOINT RESOLUTION NOS. CC 2018-071 AND SA 2018-009, A JOINT RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE REGARDING THE CANCELLATION OF THE REGULAR MEETINGS SCHEDULED FOR TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2018 AND RESCHEDULING THE MEETINGS TO NOVEMBER 13, 2018 AT 7:00 P.M.
Staff Recommendation: Move to adopt Joint Resolution Nos. CC 2018-071 and SA 2018-009. (Vote - Requires a majority vote of the total membership of the City Council/Successor Agency to adopt.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 9.1
10. NEW BUSINESS:
10.1 Approve the Community Workforce Agreement by and between the City of Palmdale and Los Angeles/Orange Counties Building and Construction Trades Council and the Signatory Craft Councils and Unions, Agreement No. A-6449. (Staff Reference: City Attorney Ditzhazy)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve Item 10.1. (Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 10.1
11. NON-AGENDA ITEMS – PUBLIC COMMENTS:
12. INFORMATIONAL REPORT FROM MAYOR AND / OR COUNCILMEMBERS ON THEIR VARIOUS COMMITTEE MEMBERSHIPS AND MEETINGS ATTENDED AT PUBLIC EXPENSE.
13. CITY COUNCIL REQUESTS FOR NEW AGENDA ITEMS.
14. ADJOURNMENT.
